title: Check Palindrome
description: Check if the given string is a palindrome (same forwards and backwards).

codeSnippet.PYTHON:
def is_palindrome(s):
    return s == s[::-1]

import sys
s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
print(str(is_palindrome(s)).lower())

refrenceSolution.PYTHON:
import sys
s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
print(str(s == s[::-1]).lower())
